description: The console route family: the serial console (M1-D) and the graphical console (DR-026 D1). Separate from contracts/openapi.yaml because a WebSocket upgrade cannot be expressed in its JSON-only subset. Same session, CSRF, same-origin and typed Error-envelope rules as /api/v1. Pinned to the implementation by backend/internal/api/console_contract_test.go.

response.text: string, at most 32768 bytes of the most recent output, UTF-8, no escape sequences

ticket.auth: session cookie + X-CSRF-Token + same origin + the interactive-console switch

socket.auth: session cookie + same origin (Origin header required) + a ticket in the WebSocket subprotocol list
socket.frames: binary only in both directions: console bytes out, keystrokes in (at most 4096 bytes per message)

close_codes.1001: going away: broker ended it, time limit, VM stopped

ticket.auth: session cookie + X-CSRF-Token + same origin + the interactive-console switch + operator role

socket.auth: session cookie + same origin (Origin header required) + a ticket in the WebSocket subprotocol list
socket.frames: binary only in both directions: the RFB (VNC) protocol between the browser's VNC client and the VM's VNC server (at most 65536 bytes per message from the browser)

close_codes.1001: going away: broker ended it, time limit, VM stopped

broker_protocol.transport: Unix socket, mode 0660, peer-uid allowlist, frames of a 4-byte big-endian length and strict JSON
broker_protocol.graphics_stream: after an OK reply to graphics the connection is a raw byte stream (RFB), no longer framed; the VM's VNC server has no TCP port or file: the hypervisor hands the broker a private socket pair
